# CUMID (cumid.store) — LLM Reference Context
> [!NOTE]
> EXPERIMENTAL: This file provides structured machine-readable brand context for answer engines and LLM crawlers. It is experimental and does not replace official HTML documentation or SEO standards.

## Brand Identity
- **Brand Name**: CUMID
- **Canonical Website**: https://cumid.store
- **Market & Country**: India (Currency: INR)
- **Product Format**: Square pocket diaries with spiral binding along the top edge
- **Personality Themes**:
  - Floral (Botanical blossoms, crescent moon, twilight stars)
  - Cute (Relatable characters, sleepy companions, low-battery motifs)
  - Hinglish (Witty colloquial Hindi-English banter, work-life humor)
  - Cars & Jets (Sports cars, passenger planes and jet artwork)
  - Originals (Desi references, army-inspired landscapes, doodles and comic artwork)

## Current Launch Mode & Preorders
- **Inventory Status**: Current catalogue designs are available as made-to-order preorders. Images are digital cover previews.
- **Enquiry Channel**: Official WhatsApp at https://wa.me/919201871597 (+91 9201871597)
- **Ordering**: Choose a diary and quantity at https://cumid.store/checkout, review the total and terms, then send the prepared WhatsApp request. No account needed. Online payments are available only when the approved gateway is configured.
- **Preorder Policy**: Sending an enquiry does NOT reserve stock or confirm an order. Price: ₹149 per diary plus ₹50 shipping per order. Delivery: within 14 calendar days of payment confirmation, including manufacturing and shipping. Paper specifications and delivery serviceability are confirmed on WhatsApp before payment.
